gs: GS1. coordinate with tour operators and travel agents
GS2. communicate effectively and patiently with tourists
GS3. prepare a checklist of documents for tour operations
GS4. record customer information for tour planning

pcs.pc_description: collect information on the type of tour to be conducted adventure, religious, heritage, etc.
obtain the tour plan with dates and duration from the agents and operators
select items and information that are relevant to include in the tour
obtain information on tourist or tour group’s details like number of elderly and babies, interests, and requirements, special needs, names, contact number, emergency contacts, etc.
coordinate with the tour operator for the meeting point and time
confirm time required to complete the tour, accommodation, budget, dietary and access requirements with appropriate authority
coordinate with travel agents/tour operators to schedule visits and purchase tickets to museums, galleries, protected parks, and other attractions
select the route and sequence of the tour to meet tour objectives
determine the pace at which information will be provided to tourists to enable a better understanding
prepare the narratives and commentary for the tour sites
ensure that the format, content, and style of presentations are engaging and appropriate
arrange the requisite equipment for each tour like GPS units, variometer, radios, etc.
greet the tourists on arrival at the meeting point as per standards
build rapport with tourists through self- introduction and asking their names
assist tourists with transfers, seating arrangements in bus, vans, etc., as required
inform the tourists about the itinerary
issue identification badges and/or safety devices, if required
ensure tourists carry water, medicine and other essentials required for a specific trip (e.g. sunscreen, mosquito repellent cream, covered shoes, hat, sunglasses, jackets, etc.)
brief the tourists about the local rules and regulations, customs, etiquette, body language, appropriate dress code and weather conditions of the destination
provide the tourists a schedule of events and calendars with the dates of various cultural shows, fairs, exhibitions and festivals, closing and opening hours of sites
guide the tourists through traditional cultures like dance, music, festivals, architecture, customs, food, language, religion, rituals, etc. at the site

ensure the tourists interact with the local people to experience the rich culture, religion, beliefs and customs and tradition of the destination, participate in celebrating festivals, and taste the local cuisine
accompany the tourists to buy local handicraft or textile as souvenirs from local workshops or shops and organize cultural shows such as local music and dance to entertain the tourists
distribute brochures, show audio-visual presentations, and explain establishment processes and operations at tour sites
recognize the difficulties experienced by the tourists in adjusting to a new environment and the type of help that can be provided
handle tourists’ complaints, if any, as per organizational SOP
take photographs of the tourists during the tour
inform the tourists about the various risks involved in the tour e.g. wind speed during hang- gliding, high tide, crevasses on the mountain trail, etc.
inform the tourists regarding emergency procedures
describe the local facilities available to deal with risks and process to access them
explain the different safety measures to be taken for the highlighted risks
arrange for safety equipment that the tourists may require, like harness, life jacket, etc. for a trip
inspect the safety equipment’s for proper functioning before providing them to the tourists
demonstrate the use of safety equipment to the tourists, if required
warn tourists of pick-pockets, snatching, theft, or any other criminal activities at a tour spot e.g. in crowded historical sites, religious places, local markets, etc.
provide first aid instructions
handle health emergencies, if any
monitor tourists' activities to ensure compliance with establishment or tour regulations and safety practices
coordinate with the tour operator on the cost if the tour is booked in advance
prepare an invoice for the trip
charge for various expenses for the tour e.g. museum tickets, entry fee for sports, cultural, and other events, etc
collect payment from tourists or travel agent/tour operator in cash or card, as applicable
complete all required tour records and customer information and keep them safe and secure
obtain and incorporate feedback from the tourists to rate the services offered

gs: GS1. read road maps, signs, symbols, signboards and related information
GS2. fill log books for the maintenance of the vehicle
GS3. coordinate with transport coordinators to achieve smooth trip
GS4. communicate effectively with the customers
GS5. plan the shortest routes for the travel

modules.module_title: Examine the vehicle before the trip

pcs.pc_description: inspect the vehicle as per the organizational work instructions/health and safety guidelines before leaving for the tour
clean and sanitize the vehicle as per organizational SOPs or vehicle user manual
test vehicle equipment, such as lights, brakes, horns, or wind shield wipers, to ensure proper operation
check fuel, oil, and water levels prior to departure
confirm the availability and validity of all the vehicle related documents as per the standards
check vehicle service record for any history of technical defects or immediate need for servicing like oil/filter change
record any anomalies or technical/compliance issues observed during an examination and cleaning the vehicle or during the previous trip
perform minor vehicle repairs such as cleaning spark plugs, etc.
report actual or potential defects to determine road worthiness of the vehicle
inform superior about any requirements such as fuel refill or repair
obtain the assigned booking details in advance from the authorized personnel
plan the best travel route based on location and estimated travel time

modules.module_title: Drive the customers to the destination

pcs.pc_description: wear proper uniform and PPE like mask, gloves, etc. as per organizational policy
reach the pre-arranged location to pick up the customers on time
greet and welcome the customers as per organizational standards
offer refreshments to the customers, if applicable
provide assistance to customers while entering or exiting the vehicle
help the customers with the luggage, if required
operate vehicles with specialized equipment, such as wheelchair lifts, to transport and secure customers with special needs
ensure the customers are seated in an orderly manner while on the vehicle
provide the customers with information about the local area and points of interest
brief the customers on the history and significance of the place
guide the customers to the famous shopping spots
handle customer’s complaints and queries, if any

modules.module_title: Conform to traffic rules and regulations

pcs.pc_description: adhere to local and state driving laws and road regulations
ensure the customers follow safety regulations like wearing seat belt, etc.
follow lane discipline and change lanes safely at appropriate speed as per traffic conditions
overtake other road users legally, safely, and by using correct signaling (e.g. use of indicators while turning left/right)
control the speed limit and distance in relation to other vehicles ahead, behind, and on the sides and maintain a safe distance
brake the vehicle in a manner appropriate to the driving conditions and the distance available for braking the vehicle
report any road accidents and traffic violations to the superior promptly

modules.module_title: Complete the trip and take customer feedback

pcs.pc_description: determine the fare based on trip distances and time
collect fares or vouchers from the customers and make change or issue receipts as necessary
obtain feedback from the customers
inform the superior about customer’s feedback
maintain mileage and kilometer logs
record and submit the vehicle logs, billing statements, etc. as per organizational standards
fill and submit the trip sheet with name, date, vehicle identification number and the destination of travel
record the time of pick up and drop, fare, the destination to which the customers travelled, and the kilometers travelled overall
fill in accident report in case of any accidents
park and cover the vehicle at the designated place in a safe manner as per the organizational SOP

gs: GS1. read and interpret all instructions, reports, regulations
GS2. communicate effectively with tourists to assist during tour
GS3. organize information relevant to the site

modules.module_title: Guide tourists on heritage, religious, and culture tours

pcs.pc_description: check for entry restrictions, dress code, prohibitions (e.g. photography, video shoot, mobile, etc.) closure at tour sites
guide through the important areas at site like monuments, archaeological sites, museum, fort, etc.
explain the site’s history and rich heritage, ancient culture, festivals and fairs and stories/anecdotes for each building, paintings, artifact, etc. and their significance
read and explain any inscriptions, if written in local language
arrange for cultural programs or events organized at the site like light and sound shows, etc.
offer any available video/ audio presentation to the tourists to explain the significance of the place
brief the tourists about the other heritage sites in and around the destination and city and their links with current site
assist the tourists in buying souvenirs or special mementos from site museum shop or shopping areas
explain the various religious festivals and faith-based activities at holy sites
inform the tourists on the offerings and vows that can be made at the site
brief the tourists about the prayer timings if they wish to be part of the prayer offerings
assist with the purchase of requirements for performing religious rituals and other faith-based activities
coordinate with priests and religious leaders at the holy site to interact with tourists for the rituals
brief tourists on pilgrim requirements, duties, and other pilgrim spots nearby

modules.module_title: Guide tourists at leisure and recreation tours

pcs.pc_description: explain the day-to-day lifestyle, occupation, local art and culture, religion of the inhabitants and the heritage and history of the location
introduce the tourists to the villagers or localities to help mingle and interact with them for first-hand experience
assist the tourists with translation or interpretation of the local language if required
make tourists aware of the environmental and social aspects of the region
organize for local cultural events and shows
guide the tourists through various attractions in and around the location
arrange for rural activities like agriculture e. g., paddy cultivation, sowing or harvesting, other attractions like horticulture, fisheries for the tourists
brief the tourists on the various eco-tour activities such as bird watching, photography, camping, star gazing, recycling, water reuse, energy efficiency, etc.
inform tourists about the destination’s beaches, waterfalls, resorts, famous local cuisines, nightlife, health clubs, shopping, amusement and theme parks, boating, etc.
brief the tourists on the various species and their habitat at the tourist spot
arrange for games, entertainment and sporting activities like tennis, swimming, etc. for interested tourists at the resort or hotel
conduct walking tours through various scenic locations
take interested tourists to other leisure places such as theatres, pubs, discotheques, galleries, museums, parks, etc. based on their preference
arrange for a candle light dinner or a beach side dinner or a themed dinner for tourists, if required
brief the tourists on the cruise destination, tour highlights, and duration of travel, etc.
escort the tourists through the cruise ship
provide a map of the cruise ship to tourists for easy access to various areas in the ship
introduce the ship’s captain and various facilitators on the ship
ensure the tourists are comfortable in the allotted cabin
explain the various facilities available on the cruise ship such as cabins, restaurant and various cuisines, casino, events and entertainment areas, gaming zone, etc.
provide the rates of the various facilities to the tourists, if not included in the trip cost
highlight the possible risks and emergency situations involved with traveling in a cruise
explain the various safety measures and use of safety equipment on board
provide a list and timing of events on the ship for the tourists to participate in e.g. music and dance performance, plays, competitions, etc.
explain the significance, associated history, festivals and the area coverage of the desert and the bordering locations
ensure the tourists get a taste of local culture through interaction with the inhabitants and learn about their lifestyle
explain the major occupation such as agriculture, animal husbandry, etc. of the desert inhabitants
check the arrangement for accommodation in tents or mud huts, if the tourist wishes to experience night life in the desert
check the type of sport the tourists are interested in such as cricket, football, tennis, chess, golf, hockey, etc.
brief the tourists on the schedule and timings of each sporting event
provide the tourists with entry ticket and passes for a preferred sports event, if required
brief on the history and the significance of any major sports events attended by the tourists such as Olympics, FIFA World cup, ICC World Cup, etc.
explain the various rules and regulations of the sport if the tourist is new to witnessing a sport event
provide the names of the players in the event and the details of famous players in the team
brief the tourists on the current status, score, competitors, rank and position and other details about the sports event that the tourist is visiting
arrange for transportation of the tourists from the place of stay to the sporting venue, if required
brief the tourist on the various cuisines available at the tourist spot such as Indian, Italian, Mexican, Thai, Continental, etc.
encourage tourists to explore various kinds of cuisine
arrange for a sample food tasting for tourists to determine their preference
provide the tourists with food festival schedule
inform the tourists about the popular food items and their ingredients and health benefits
explain the heritage and history of the different cuisines
ensure the tourists experience their food with the best ambience such as beachside, riverside, candlelight, etc. for a memorable eating and drinking experience

modules.module_title: Guide tourists on wellness and medical tours

pcs.pc_description: obtain the medical records of the tourists before and kind of wellness or medical treatment the tourist is visiting for
ensure tourists have appropriate accommodation as part of the wellness package
explain the various types of wellness activities and therapies such as yoga, Ayurveda, naturopathy, spa, siddha, etc.
brief on the origin, significance and the benefits of each wellness activity
escort the tourists to the appropriate activity centers as per their needs such as weight loss, pain and stress relief, beauty treatment, ageing
introduce the tourists to the wellness facilitators
check the accommodation and food arrangements are as per the requirement of the tourists
